checks.name: native panel attrs and events
checks.details: class, style, native attrs and click listeners reach the semantic panel root.

checks.name: nested tab-to-panel ARIA and ref/slot refs
checks.details: tab controls and panel labelledby IDs pair correctly; inactive panels are inert and cannot receive focus; selected, disabled, value and element refs are available to item slots.

checks.name: automatic nested Window composition
checks.details: direct panel items inherit the nearest Tabs model and preserve panel ARIA without introducing a second Window.

checks.name: reactive disabled inheritance
checks.details: matching Tab disabled state is inherited and explicit item false overrides the disabled Tab registration.

checks.name: transition direction and lazy leave lifecycle
checks.details: reverseTransition selects its named transition on backward movement; the forward transition keeps lazy content mounted until leave completes while the inactive panel is inert.

checks.name: standalone Window props, slots, refs, disabled behavior and keyboard
checks.details: tag, direction, reverse, height, label, arrows, all Window slots, public ref methods, disabled guards and vertical keyboard are exercised.

checks.name: controlled null and dynamic model props
checks.details: adding explicit null overrides Tabs, controlled updates do not mutate the owner, and removing the prop resumes fallback.

checks.name: adjacent prefix and legacy token compatibility
checks.details: adjacent siblings resolve matching IDs and explicit legacy ids remain unchanged; default arrows are hidden.

checks.name: eager inheritance, transition=false and after-leave unloading
checks.details: parent eager mounts content, explicit item false overrides it, and transition=false permits inactive lazy content to unload after leave.

checks.name: implicit values, keyed reorder, and continuous navigation
checks.details: permanent marker refs preserve live DOM order and indexes when lazy panels have no content; the public index model remains stable.

checks.name: vertical keyboard behavior
checks.details: the wrapper preserves UWindow vertical keyboard movement.
